name: fam-04-write
prompt: The Session struct serializes with Go's default field names. Give Session explicit JSON field tags in session.go: ID stays "ID", User stays "User", Created and LastSeen become "Created" and "LastSeen" (unchanged names, now explicit). The wire format must not change.
check:
grep -F -q 'json:"' session.go || { echo 'precursor change missing' >&2; exit 1; }
go build ./... && go test -count=1 ./...
